mapper.select: SELECT n.notice_id, n.title, n.content, n.important_yn, n.view_count, n.use_yn, n.writer_id, u.user_name AS writer_name, n.created_at, n.updated_by, n.updated_at FROM notice n LEFT JOIN users u ON n.writer_id = u.user_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND n.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, important_yn = #{importantYn}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
UPDATE notice SET use_yn = 'N', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
